concept.title: People with sight loss
concept.shortdesc: Blind, partially sighted or visually impaired people of any age, including those with dual sight and hearing loss, and their parents.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.
